long_biography.plain_text:
Al Marzouq trained in finance at Kuwait University and developed a parallel public profile around Arabian horses. Through Ajmal Stud, he bred purebred Arabians and helped organise Kuwait's first national Arabian-horse beauty championship. He later chaired the board of trustees of Bait Al Arab, the Kuwait State Stud, and became its honorary chairman.

His sporting patronage later extended to tennis. Tamdeen financed and developed the Sheikh Jaber Al-Abdullah Al-Jaber Al-Sabah International Tennis Complex, combining a stadium, academy and indoor courts with 360 Kuwait. In 2026, the Kuwait Tennis Federation named Al Marzouq its honorary president, citing his sustained support for facilities, young players and the national game.
